svg.title: Power delivery path from TVA generation to JEA customers, with cross-ties
svg.desc: Tiered one-line diagram showing generation at 13.8 to 24 kV, TVA transmission at 161 to 500 kV, JEA subtransmission at 46 kV, JEA primary distribution at 12470Y/7200 V, and customer utilization voltages, with three cross-tie points marked.
svg.text: Power delivery path: TVA generation to JEA customer, with cross-ties
1 - Transmission interconnection: TVA network is a mesh, tied to neighboring utilities and LPCs.
2 - 46 kV subtransmission loop tie, normally closed. Two sources feed one loop.
3 - Distribution feeder tie, normally OPEN. This is the FLISR restoration path.
4 - Substation bus tie breaker, normally open. Backs up a failed transformer in the same sub.
